collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.before: An elder known for fine needlework can
ledger.after: (Name1), an elder known for fine needlework, can
ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: An elder known for fine needlework can no longer see the smallest stitches but has a festival garment to finish.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), an elder known for fine needlework, can no longer see the smallest stitches but has a festival garment to finish.

choices.label: Ask a Grandchild to Thread the Needles.
Ask Another Sewer to Finish the Fine Parts.
Try a Lens of Polished Clear Stone.
Change the Design to Larger Stitches.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The grandchild threads needles all afternoon and learns several stitches along the way.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The grandchild's threading is crooked at first, and they both laugh before it improves.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The finished garment combines both of their work beautifully.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The other sewer's stitches look different, and the elder decides they like the variety.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The lens makes the stitches large enough to see, and the elder works happily.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The lens gives the elder a headache, so they return to asking for help.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The bold new pattern becomes the most admired garment at the festival.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The elder misses the old fine work but finishes the garment proudly.
